noneuclid.portal: A doorway to another place. Walking across the Region's center line continues the walk out of the exit Region, and looking through it shows the space beyond the exit. Draw it as a strip across a doorway with walls on both sides.
noneuclid.fold: Cuts the Region out of space and joins its opposite edges. A long hallway with a fold over its middle looks long from outside but is short to walk, and looking down it shows the far end up close.
noneuclid.impossibleSpace: The Region is bigger or smaller on the inside: movement through it costs more or less than its drawn size.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Log extra details about portals and other non-Euclidean effects to the browser console.

exit.label: Exit
exit.hint: The Region the portal leads to. In the same Scene the passage is seamless; in another Scene the Token is teleported.

crossing.label: Crossing Direction
crossing.hint: The direction Tokens walk through the portal and its exit. Automatic assumes each Region is a strip drawn across a doorway, so they walk across its short side.

flip.label: Flip
flip.hint: Come out of the exit heading the opposite way.

twoWay.label: Two-Way
twoWay.hint: Automatically give the exit a portal leading back here.

Portal.NoCrossScenePermission: You do not have permission to move Tokens between Scenes.

scale.label: Inside Scale
scale.hint: How many times longer distances are inside the Region. 2 means bigger on the inside; 0.5 means smaller.

direction.label: Shortened Direction
direction.hint: The direction of travel the fold removes. Automatic uses the Region's longer side, as for a Region drawn along a hallway.
